```{r}

na_summary <- data.frame(
  column = names(df_original),
  n_na = sapply(df_original, function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
  pct_na = sapply(df_original, function(x) mean(is.na(x))) * 100
)

# sort by highest NA %
na_summary <- na_summary %>% arrange(desc(pct_na))

na_summary

```

```{r}

# Features having less than threshold% nulls

null_threshold = 35

keep_cols <- na_summary %>%
  filter(pct_na < null_threshold) %>%
  pull(column)

# df of cols having less than threshold% nulls
df_less_than_null_threshold <- df_original %>%
  select(all_of(keep_cols))
```


```{r}
dim(df_original)
dim(df_less_than_null_threshold)
```


```{r}

```

```{r}

# ================================
# E) Drop rows with any NA (complete-case analysis)
# ================================
df_no_na <- df_less_than_null_threshold %>% drop_na()
cat("Length after dropping rows with at least one NA:", nrow(df_no_na), "\n")

# ================================
# E.1) Convert data types AFTER complete-case filtering
# ================================

# Convert numeric features (currently character) to numeric
df_no_na <- df_no_na %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(intersect(num_feat, names(df_no_na))),
                ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))))

# Convert categorical features to factors
df_no_na <- df_no_na %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(intersect(cat_feat, names(df_no_na))),
                as.factor))

# ================================
# F) Create binary target
# ================================
df_no_na <- df_no_na %>%
  mutate(scene_time_binary = if_else(EMSSceneTimeMin <= 10, 0L, 1L))

# ================================
# G) Build single working dataset (NO train/test split)
#    - Remove leakage target + identifier
#    - Keep target as factor {0,1}
# ================================
work_df <- df_no_na %>%
  select(-EMSSceneTimeMin, -PcrKey) %>%
  mutate(scene_time_binary = factor(scene_time_binary, levels = c(0, 1)))

target_col <- "scene_time_binary"
alpha <- 0.05
cor_cutoff <- 0.8

# Ensure categorical predictors are factors for chi-square
work_df <- work_df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(intersect(cat_feat, names(work_df))), as.factor))


```

```{r}

# ================================
# TRACK REMOVED FEATURES BY TECHNIQUE
# ================================
removed <- list(
  correlation = character(0),
  nzv = character(0),
  chi_square = character(0),
  kruskal = character(0)
)

drop_cols <- function(df, cols_to_drop) {
  cols_to_drop <- intersect(cols_to_drop, colnames(df))
  df <- df[, !(colnames(df) %in% cols_to_drop), drop = FALSE]
  list(df = df, dropped = cols_to_drop)
}

```

```{r}

# ================================
# 1) CORRELATION FILTER (numeric only)
# ================================
existing_num <- intersect(num_feat, colnames(work_df))
existing_num <- setdiff(existing_num, target_col)

reduced_num_cols <- existing_num

if (length(existing_num) >= 2) {
  cor_obj <- rcorr(as.matrix(work_df[, existing_num, drop = FALSE]), type = "spearman")
  cor_r <- cor_obj$r
  cor_p <- cor_obj$P
  diag(cor_p) <- 0

  # Optional: save significance-only heatmap
  #custom_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#6D9EC1", "white", "#E46767"))(200)
  #png("correlation_heatmap_sig_only_largefont.png", width = 1000, height = 1000)
  #corrplot(cor_r,
           # method = "color",p.mat = cor_p,sig.level = alpha,insig = "blank",col = custom_palette,number.cex = 1.1,tl.cex = # 1.2,cl.cex = 1.1,tl.col = "black")
  #dev.off()

  drop_cor_idx <- findCorrelation(cor_r, cutoff = cor_cutoff)

  if (length(drop_cor_idx) > 0) {
    removed$correlation <- existing_num[drop_cor_idx]
    reduced_num_cols <- setdiff(existing_num, removed$correlation)

    out <- drop_cols(work_df, removed$correlation)
    work_df <- out$df
  }
}

cat("After correlation step, cols:", ncol(work_df), "\n")

```

```{r}

# ================================
# 2) NEAR-ZERO VARIANCE (predictors only)
# ================================
predictor_cols <- setdiff(colnames(work_df), target_col)

nzv <- nearZeroVar(work_df[, predictor_cols, drop = FALSE], saveMetrics = TRUE)
removed$nzv <- rownames(nzv[nzv$nzv == TRUE, , drop = FALSE])

if (length(removed$nzv) > 0) {
  out <- drop_cols(work_df, removed$nzv)
  work_df <- out$df
}

cat("After NZV step, cols:", ncol(work_df), "\n")

```

```{r}

# ================================
# 3) CHI-SQUARE (categorical ~ target) with BH correction
#    - Uses simulated p-value when expected counts are small
# ================================
existing_cats <- setdiff(intersect(cat_feat, colnames(work_df)), target_col)

chi_p <- sapply(existing_cats, function(col) {
  tbl <- table(work_df[[col]], work_df[[target_col]])
  if (min(dim(tbl)) <= 1) return(NA_real_)

  test <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tbl))
  if (any(test$expected < 5)) {
    suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 2000)$p.value)
  } else {
    test$p.value
  }
})

chi_p_adj <- p.adjust(chi_p, method = "BH")

significant_cat_vars <- names(chi_p_adj)[!is.na(chi_p_adj) & chi_p_adj < alpha]
removed$chi_square <- setdiff(existing_cats, significant_cat_vars)

if (length(removed$chi_square) > 0) {
  out <- drop_cols(work_df, removed$chi_square)
  work_df <- out$df
}

cat("After chi-square step, cols:", ncol(work_df), "\n")


```

```{r}

# ================================
# 4) KRUSKAL-WALLIS (numeric ~ target) with BH correction
# ================================
num_for_kw <- setdiff(intersect(reduced_num_cols, colnames(work_df)), target_col)

kw_p <- sapply(num_for_kw, function(col) {
  tryCatch(kruskal.test(work_df[[col]] ~ work_df[[target_col]])$p.value,
           error = function(e) NA_real_)
})

kw_p_adj <- p.adjust(kw_p, method = "BH")

significant_num_vars <- names(kw_p_adj)[!is.na(kw_p_adj) & kw_p_adj < alpha]
removed$kruskal <- setdiff(num_for_kw, significant_num_vars)

if (length(removed$kruskal) > 0) {
  out <- drop_cols(work_df, removed$kruskal)
  work_df <- out$df
}

cat("After kruskal step, cols:", ncol(work_df), "\n")

```

```{r}

# ================================
# 5) FINAL FEATURE SET + REPORTS
# ================================
final_vars <- c(significant_cat_vars, significant_num_vars)
final_vars <- final_vars[!is.na(final_vars)]
final_vars <- intersect(final_vars, colnames(work_df))  # safety

cat("\nFinal features selected for modeling:\n")
print(final_vars)

cat("\nFinal dataset shape (selected + target):\n")
print(dim(work_df[, c(final_vars, target_col), drop = FALSE]))

cat("\n================ REMOVED FEATURES BY TECHNIQUE ================\n")
cat("\nCorrelation removed:\n"); print(removed$correlation)
cat("\nNZV removed:\n"); print(removed$nzv)
cat("\nChi-square removed:\n"); print(removed$chi_square)
cat("\nKruskal-Wallis removed:\n"); print(removed$kruskal)

removed_all <- sort(unique(unlist(removed)))
cat("\nTOTAL UNIQUE REMOVED FEATURES:\n")
print(removed_all)


```

```{r}

# ================================
# Combine all removed columns
# ================================
# ================================
# Columns removed due to NA threshold
# ================================
removed_na <- setdiff(names(df_original), keep_cols)

# ================================
# Combine ALL removed columns
# ================================
removed_all <- unique(c(
  cols_to_drop,      # manual / design drops
  removed_na,        # high-missingness drops
  unlist(removed)    # correlation / nzv / stats filters
))

length(removed_all)

# ================================
# Persist for Python pipeline
# ================================
write.csv(
  data.frame(column = removed_all),
  "../Stat_Outputs/removed_features.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

drop_df <- data.frame(column_name = cols_to_drop)
write.csv(drop_df,
          "../Stat_Outputs/cols_to_drop.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

num_df <- data.frame(column_name = num_feat)
write.csv(num_df,
          "../Stat_Outputs/num_feat.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
